The **Top 10 Shootout** at the **Bathurst 1000** (officially known as the **Repco Bathurst 1000**) is a thrilling qualifying session where the fastest 10 drivers from regular qualifying compete for pole position in a single-lap shootout.

Here are the winners of the **Top 10 Shootout** at Bathurst over the past few years:

### **Recent Top 10 Shootout Winners (Supercars Championship)**
| **Year** | **Driver** | **Team** | **Car** |
|----------|------------|----------|---------|
| **2023** | **Shane van Gisbergen** | Triple Eight Race Engineering | Chevrolet Camaro ZL1 |
| **2022** | **Chaz Mostert** | Walkinshaw Andretti United | Holden Commodore ZB |
| **2021** | **Shane van Gisbergen** | Triple Eight Race Engineering | Holden Commodore ZB |
| **2020** | **Scott McLaughlin** | DJR Team Penske | Ford Mustang GT |
| **2019** | **Scott McLaughlin** | DJR Team Penske | Ford Mustang GT |
| **2018** | **David Reynolds** | Erebus Motorsport | Holden Commodore ZB |
| **2017** | **Scott McLaughlin** | Garry Rogers Motorsport | Volvo S60 |
| **2016** | **Will Davison** | Tekno Autosports | Holden Commodore VF |
| **2015** | **Mark Winterbottom** | Prodrive Racing Australia | Ford Falcon FG X |
| **2014** | **Will Davison** | Erebus Motorsport | Mercedes-Benz E63 AMG |

### **Notable Facts:**
- **Shane van Gisbergen** has been dominant in recent years, winning the Shootout in **2021, 2023**, and also setting the **fastest ever lap** at Bathurst (2:03.191 in 2023).
- **Scott McLaughlin** won three Shootouts in a row (2017, 2019, 2020) before moving to IndyCar.
- **Chaz Mostert** holds the record for the **most Shootout wins (3)** (2014, 2017, 2022).
